name: Potion of Vitality

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Ends Exhaustion and the Poisoned condition; for 24 hours, Hit Point Dice you spend heal their maximum.
text: This crimson potion pulses with a dull glow like a heartbeat. Drinking it clears every level of Exhaustion you have and rids you of the Poisoned condition, and for the next 24 hours every Hit Point Die you spend restores its maximum number of Hit Points.
